text.content:
The jewel of the resort, with the lights off.

Region: Pacifica (district P). Was: the south of Pacifica Playground, Playland by the Sea
Controlled by: Nobody official, at night
The feel of it: Squatters in the show homes, scavvers stripping copper from the rides
Notable locations: Hotel Pistis Sophia (#49), Serenity Bible Church (#50), Playland by the Sea, the Beach Club
Danger: Combat. SC 2 (none; NCPD drive-through, Medium). UC 9

Officially still Night City. Squatter families live in the empty show homes alongside scavengers, an Animals pack, cultists at the Serenity Bible Church, and the occasional rich eccentric who never left.

Places

  • Hotel Pistis Sophia (#49). SC 2. Abandoned luxury; squatters in the penthouses, a Voodoo Boy relay on the roof.
  • Serenity Bible Church (#50). SC 3. A megachurch built for the resort; services for the squatters, free food and long sermons about the Flood.
  • Playland by the Sea. SC 1. Reborn in 2065, dead again by 2069. The ferris wheel still stands. Something lives in the haunted house.
  • The Beach Club. SC 3: the Animals. The Sharks pack's gym, with fight nights by the empty pool.

Getting There

NCART: West Wind, Playland (Pacifica Line, suspended).

Turf

Voodoo Boys, the Animals, squatters.

People

  • Reverend Tobias Grey (Media 4). Feeds anyone, and preaches that the resort's fall was judgment, and that judgment isn't finished.
  • Big Mako (Ganger 6, Animals). Alpha of the Sharks pack.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.12
